tagline: Two forms, one deck — hit hard at HIGH TIDE, slip away at LOW, and flip at will

featuredCards.title: Deep Draught
featuredCards.caption: Two cards and a free flip. Getting into the right stance costs almost nothing in this deck.

featuredCards.title: Crash and Recede
featuredCards.caption: Strike, walk three spaces, change form. Every tide card is a repositioning card as well.

featuredCards.title: The Tide Turns!
featuredCards.caption: A 4 with a 4 on the back that switches her stance as it resolves. Attack now, defend next.

featuredCards.title: Tidepool Mirror
featuredCards.caption: Two of three: cards, health, or a teleport out. The low-tide defence bonus lands on top of it.
